name: Terminal 10
definition: Payment terminal or ATM performing the transaction

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of terminal. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

ReadingCapability.name: Reading Capability
ReadingCapability.definition: Card reading capability of the terminal performing the transaction. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

WritingCapability.name: Writing Capability
WritingCapability.definition: Card writing or output capabilities of the terminal performing the transaction. P0P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

PINLengthCapability.name: PIN Length Capability
PINLengthCapability.definition: Maximum number of digits that the Point of Interaction is able to accept when the cardholder enters its PIN.

PINEntryCapability.name: PIN Entry Capability
PINEntryCapability.definition: Describe the capability of acceptance device to support PINs.

ApprovalCodeLength.name: Approval Code Length
ApprovalCodeLength.definition: Maximum number of characters of the approval code that the acquirer is able to manage.

MaxScriptLength.name: Max Script Length
MaxScriptLength.definition: Maximum data length in bytes that a card issuer can return to the ICC at the terminal.

CardCaptureCapable.name: Card Capture Capable
CardCaptureCapable.definition: Indicates whether the terminal can capture cards or not.|True: The terminal is able to capture cards|False: The terminal is not able to capture cards.

OnLineCapability.name: On Line Capability
OnLineCapability.definition: Capability of the terminal to go online.

MessageCapability.name: Message Capability
MessageCapability.definition: Capability of the terminal to display or print messages to the cardholder or the merchant.

CardholderVerificationCapability.name: Cardholder Verification Capability
CardholderVerificationCapability.definition: Cardholder verification capabilities performing the transaction at the point of service. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

TemporarySecureStorage.name: Temporary Secure Storage
TemporarySecureStorage.definition: Terminal is capable of temporary secure storage of the card details for reuse upon permission of the card issuer.|Default meaning when not present: false.

IntegrationType.name: Integration Type
IntegrationType.definition: Type of terminal integration at a point of service location.

Outdoor.name: Outdoor
Outdoor.definition: Indicates whether the terminal is operated outdoor or indoor at the point of service.|True: The terminal is operated outdoor|False: The terminal is operated indoor

OffPremises.name: Off Premises
OffPremises.definition: Indicates whether the terminal is operated on- or off-premises at the point of service.|True: The terminal is operated off premises.|False: The terminal is operated on premises.

OnBoard.name: On Board
OnBoard.definition: Indicates whether the transaction was performed on board.||True: The terminal is located on board.|False: The terminal is not located on board.

SerialNumber.name: Serial Number
SerialNumber.definition: Serial number identifying an occurrence of an hardware component.

TerminalLineEncryptionCertified.name: Terminal Line Encryption Certified
TerminalLineEncryptionCertified.definition: Indicates whether or not the POS terminal from which the|transaction occurred is Terminal Line Encryption (TLE)-certified.

UniqueKeyPerTerminalCertified.name: Unique Key Per Terminal Certified
UniqueKeyPerTerminalCertified.definition: Indicates whether the terminal has encryption certification for unique key per terminal implementations. This includes technologies such as:|- UKPT (Unique Key Per Terminal)|- DUKPT (Derived Unique Key Per Transaction)|- Other key management schemes|||`true` - Terminal is certified for unique key per terminal encryption|`false` - Terminal is not certified or uses alternative encryption methods

EncryptionMethod.name: Encryption Method
EncryptionMethod.definition: Specific encryption method/standard used by the terminal

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
